name: dev.changefeed/transaction-explainer
title: Transaction Explainer
description: Any Ethereum or Base transaction in plain words, with red flags. Paid per call via x402.

tools.name: tx_status
tools.description: Free: status (success, failed, pending), block, confirmations, fee, what kind of transaction it is, and how many red flags it has, without the details. About 20 calls a minute per client.

hash.description: Transaction hash, 0x followed by 64 hex characters

tools.name: explain_transaction
tools.description: Plain-words explanation of one Ethereum or Base transaction: a one-line summary (swap, send, approval, bridge, deposit, NFT transfer, failed call), every token and NFT movement with symbols, the account's net change, approvals (incl. Permit2), protocols touched, and red flags: unlimited or wallet approvals, look-alike tokens, address-poisoning spam, failed calls. Handles smart-account (ERC-4337) and gasless USDC (EIP-3009 / x402) transactions. Costs $0.01 (x402, USDC).

hash.description: Transaction hash, 0x followed by 64 hex characters
